delta_e_map — IMGMETRICS colordiff op

• Data kinds: rgbimage × rgbimage → image2d

• Call: import imgmetrics; imgmetrics.delta_e_map(rgb1, rgb2, kind='2000', white=(0.95047, 1.0, 1.08883)) (or opsimgmetrics.get("delta_e_map"))

Usage

Per-pixel colour-difference map between two sRGB images.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

RGB の平均二乗誤差ではなく知覚的な色差で見るための入口。

`kind は "2000"(既定)または "76"`。
